root_cause.text: The `tcf_csum_act` function in `net/sched/act_csum.c` accesses and pulls nested VLAN headers from `skb->data` without first verifying that the full VLAN header is present in the linear area of the socket buffer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a check `if (!pskb_may_pull(skb, VLAN_HLEN)) goto drop;` before casting `skb->data` to `struct vlan_hdr *` and reading `vlan->h_vlan_encapsulated_proto`. The commit message also states that "The current code reads vlan->h_vlan_encapsulated_proto and then pulls VLAN_HLEN bytes without first ensuring that the full VLAN header is present in the linear area."
